attribution.modifications: Original texture-free flat-colour geometry on the 3DBAG LoD2.2 shell (CC BY 4.0) of BAG pand 0363100012176171 (CC0): the banded sandstone canal front with its pilaster strips, five axes of sash windows with glazing bars, the arched entrance with its fanlight, pilasters and cornice, the two statues beside the centre window, the attic's paired oval windows, the cornice and roof balustrade, the stoop and area railings, the brick side with its tall windows and the shop front at the back, read from Gemeente Amsterdam panoramas (CC BY 4.0).
